summary:
w122 research done; notes.md in the stage directory, seven parts.
Accepted: r43 (active window), r60, r61, r62 under batch-measurement; deprecated r43 scenario retired.
Run by node id: deprecated r43 passes today; r43 active fails (a Given's 'messages at' cell refused by measure); r60 fails at a 3-column table unpacked as 7; r61 and r62 fail on undefined Givens.
Probes (P1-P6, probe_sessions.py): --sessions is start-only today; the store is not read for directory sessions; show and compare carry no per-session trips, tools or compactions.
Defects: D1 --sessions missing or empty dir gives exit 0 and sessions []; D2 totals print round trips 0 when no transcript found.
Conflict for the plan (both readings in notes part 4): tool uses and compactions read from the store (as round trips) or from the directory transcript.
Skipped step (part 5): round trips for directory sessions never use the store path or its subagent exclusion.
No test run was possible for non-accepted scenarios: the work-item filter deselects them (read only).
Tools: no map, so tests-of and untested not run; refs missed from-imports; counts by search.
git status clean; scratch is ignored.
